{{Top|leg}}
The '''self-sustaining unit''' reprogrammed the internal systems of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] so that the basic diagnostic routines would have been capable of self-repair. Through several complex processes, a droid could have sustained and repaired itself, regardless of the availability of repair kits.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[T3-M4]] is able to equip this item.
